$Comment: The base every zc encounter script builds on. It is Abstract, so it never spawns on its own: a
boss is a Variant of it (Type Variant, Reference Zc_Encounter_Base, Modify the parameters below)
or a Generic script that copies its shape.
What it does, in order. A Player sensor with the EncounterMembers collector keeps the roster the
boss bar and the music are applied through, and the roster the library credits presence from. In
Intro, while nothing is bound in SubjectSlot, TriggerSpawners fires the SpawnMarker within
SummonRange and binds the first spawn into the slot; the moment the Target sensor sees it, the
boss is made vulnerable, the bar goes up under BossBarName, the Music starts, the zc:engaged beat
tells the library the fight is on, and the state moves to Fight. In Fight, the FightBehavior slot
runs whatever macro a Variant hands it (Zc_Adds_Wave, say, or a macro of your own on the
Hytale.Instruction.Encounter.Phase.Behavior interface), and the moment the Target sensor loses
the boss the defeat beat clears the bar, stops the music, releases the slot and sends
zc:defeated. Complete waits RearmSeconds, sends zc:reset and returns to Intro, so the same
entity runs the fight again the next time a player comes near.
The release runs on the Target sensor alone, so a boss role does not have to send a beacon to
start the fight. Phase transitions are not in this base: add them in a Generic script with the
Zc_Phase_At_Health macro, or set FightBehavior to a macro that carries them.
A blocking action list keeps running only while its sensor keeps matching, and a sensor marked
Once is spent after its first tick. So a list that spans ticks (a Timeout, a wait for a spawn)
sits under a plain sensor and ends with the state change that stops it, the way Complete does
here; the content audit warns about a blocking list under a Once sensor.
The library reads the zc: beats and nothing else: it credits everyone who fought, scales the
boss's health with the party, pays what the binding row under
Server/ZiggfreedCommon/Encounters names, and fires the feedback moments. Override this file by
id from your own pack to change the skeleton for every script built on it.

SubjectSlot.Description: The target slot the boss is bound into and tracked through. Name the same slot in the binding row's Subject.TargetSlot.

SpawnMarker.Description: The manual-trigger spawn marker that raises the boss. Author one for your boss under Server/NPC/Spawn/Markers and stamp it into the arena.

SummonRange.Description: How far from the encounter entity a spawn marker may be to be fired.

SensorRange.Description: How close a player has to stand to count as a member of the fight.

TargetRange.Description: How far the bound boss may roam before the Target sensor loses it.

BossBarName.Description: The lang key the boss bar shows, resolved on each player's own client.

Music.Description: The MusicContainer started for every member at the release and stopped at the defeat.

FightBehavior.Description: A macro on the Hytale.Instruction.Encounter.Phase.Behavior interface run while the fight is on, or $Null for none. Zc_Adds_Wave is one.

RearmSeconds.Description: How long after the defeat the script waits before it re-arms for the next run, as a [min, max] range.
